Men's Basketball 09.26.2026

Men’s and Women’s Basketball Season Tickets Now On Sale

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:32
Instaread

Story Links

  • Purchase Men's Tickets
  • Purchase Women's Tickets
HONOLULU — Season tickets for the 2026-27 University of Hawai'i men's and women's basketball seasons are now on sale. 
 
Season tickets may be purchased at www.etickethawaii.com or at the Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center box office (Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.).

The men's squad, coming off an NCAA Tournament season, will host 18 regular-season home games. The non-conference slate starts the first week of November and  includes the 60th edition of the OUTRIGGER Rainbow Classic, the longest-running tournament in the nation. The team's inaugural season in the Mountain West includes nine contests beginning with a January 12 matchup versus Air Force and concluding with Senior Night versus UNLV on March 6.   

The Rainbow Warriors boast 13 newcomers – a talented and seasoned mixture of transfers and foreign imports. The 'Bows also return senior guards Tanner Cuff and Isaiah Kerr from last year's conference tournament championship squad.

The UH women's team enters its first season under the leadership of new head coach Khalilah Mitchell. The Rainbow Wahine schedule features 15 home dates, starting with the Bank of Hawai'i Classic (Nov. 13 and 15). The American Savings Bank Rainbow Wahine Showdown (Nov. 27-29) includes postseason participants in San Diego State, Columbia and Stanford. The 'Bows open their inaugural season in the Mountain West at home against Nevada on Dec. 30 and celebrate Senior Night on March 2 against UNLV.
 
The Rainbow Wahine return eight letterwinners from last season's 22-11 team, including guard Bailey Flavell, last season's Big West Freshman of the Year, and center Ritorya Tamilo, who was voted the conference's Best Sixth Player.

Men's Basketball Season Prices

Upper Level Adult: $150 - $250

Upper Level Student (Ages 4 – high school): $50 - $75
